title: LG showcases AI-powered OLED, Micro RGB TV lineup in Ayala Museum launch
summary: LG Electronics showcased its latest generation of AI-powered televisions during its "A Canvas of Possibilities" media launch held on October 30, 2026, at the Ayala Museum in Makati.
